text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Hmph...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I suppose you could call it 'not a bad 
run.' Well, if I had to say...
choice_data_list:
Your results are finally catching up to 
your talent.

Your results are finally catching up to 
your talent.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, indeed. It's almost too late, in 
fact. After all, I am a first-rate—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: King Halo!! Way to go!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "What's the next race? Tell me, King!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Where am I supposed to prove that 'Proof 
of a King' thing, anyway!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. What is this "King's Proof" 
nonsense? I haven't said anything like 
that to any media outlet, have I?
choice_data_list:
Everyone is completely captivated by the 
"King."

Everyone is completely captivated by the 
"King," aren't they?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. What hopeless fans they 
are.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now then...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? King Halo-san!? What are you doing 
here...?

text_block_list.name: Staff B
text_block_list.text:
W-We need to get ready for the next race 
too, though...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Rest assured. It won't take long. It's 
merely interacting with a fan, after all."

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, no way! King, you act super bossy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's not 'acting high and mighty,' I 
*am* high and mighty. Could you not get 
that mixed up?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I am a first-rate Umamusume! I am 
King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Everyone, are you really that 
curious about my future path?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I'm so curious!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, then allow me to tell you! Next up is 
the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In the race that heralds the start of the 
autumn GⅠ season, King shall once again 
reign as the Sprint Queen!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who charms you all first in 
both spring and autumn... That's me, King 
Halo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, our next goal is the 
Sprinters Stakes, alright?
choice_data_list: If that's the path you've chosen...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you really asking this King such a 
thing after all this time?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even though you know better than anyone 
that whatever path I walk becomes my own 
road.
